messages:
pagerduty-bot: ALERT: runtime-prod cluster: repeated OOMs on gpu-pool-7 (high severity) — routing to #incidents and paging on-call.

sofia: got the page, jumping in. seeing increased paging counts and GPU mem fragmentation on the dashboard. moving to live triage.

raj: oncall here. can someone paste last 10m of runtime logs and `nvidia-smi` snapshot? need to know if this is steady leak vs fragmentation.

michelle: grabbing logs now. attaching quick dump below.

michelle: ```
# nvidia-smi --query-gpu=index,memory.total,memory.used,memory.free --format=csv
index, memory.total [MiB], memory.used [MiB], memory.free [MiB]
0, 24576 MiB, 23540 MiB, 1036 MiB
1, 24576 MiB, 23980 MiB, 596 MiB
```

michelle: runtime service logs (tail):
```
2026-03-15T15:02:12Z runtime[pid=4231]: KVCache: page_count=1387 free_pages=34
2026-03-15T15:02:15Z runtime[pid=4231]: Alloc failed for batch_size=32 seq_len=1024, required=1.2GB, available=512MB
2026-03-15T15:02:16Z runtime[pid=4231]: OOM on device 1, pid=4289
2026-03-15T15:02:17Z runtime[pid=4231]: fallback triggered -> smaller-model-1
```

sofia: looks like batches of 32 with long seqs triggered a burst. KV cache free_pages low => fragmentation hypothesis.

liam: +1. I see frequent small frees in pmap, indicative of slab fragmentation. We've seen this before after enabling `continuous-batching` on that pool.

raj: immediate mitigation: reduce max batch size for hosted inference route routing to gpu-pool-7 and push canary config. who can flip that?

michelle: I can push a temp override. Proposed: set route batch_limit=8 and disable continuous-batching on that pool for 30m.

eva: FYI this route serves several paid customers. we'll need to assess customer impact if latency spikes. product will want a list.

sofia: michelle, do the override. raj, can you notify support to throttle customer traffic if spike persists?

raj: will open a CS ticket and add to this thread.

michelle: applying patch now:
```
# adminctl set-route-config --route runtime/multi-gen --pool gpu-pool-7 --batch_limit 8 --continuous_batching false --reason "live mitigation: fragmentation OOMs"
```

infra-bot: CONFIG-APPLY: route runtime/multi-gen updated on gpu-pool-7 by michelle at 2026-03-15T15:05:03Z (change-id: cfg-98324).

michelle: rolling restart of runtime workers on pool 7 to flush fragmented slabs. doing one AZ at a time.

sofia: while restarts are running, let's gather more evidence for RCA:
- collect pmap/slab histograms from the affected GPU nodes
- capture KV cache eviction logs and hit/miss rates for last 2 hours
- record batch-size distribution and seq_len distribution for the route

liam: running slab histogram script now, outputting to /tmp/rca-gpu7-1745.tgz and uploading to shared bucket.

michelle: KV cache metrics: eviction rate spiked right before the OOMs; eviction latencies increased. Hit ratio dropped from 92% -> 54% at the time of incident.

sofia: hypothesis A (primary): KV cache fragmentation + high batch_size/long seqs -> allocation fails even though aggregate free memory exists.

sofia: hypothesis B: a memory leak in recent commit to `kv-allocator` causing slow growth in reserved pages and reducing contiguous ranges.

liam: quick check: `git log -n 5 --pretty=oneline` shows `kv-allocator` touch 3 days ago (PR #2124). Could be related.

raj: assign owners for hypotheses: liam on fragmentation analysis, michelle on config/batching impact, sofia coordinating timeline and customer impact. raj handling comms.

michelle: temporary customer mitigation in place (batch_limit=8). early telemetry: paging events dropped 80% and error rate halved for the route.

eva: thanks — support reporting a drop in 5xxs but KPIs show 20% latency increase for some customers. flagging for CS.

sofia: timeline so far:
- 15:01: pagerduty alert: gpu-pool-7 repeated OOMs
- 15:03: on-call paged (raj)
- 15:05: config override applied (batch_limit=8, disable continuous batching)
- 15:06: rolling restarts started AZ-by-AZ
- 15:09: eviction rate and paging trending down

michelle: saved heap/dmesg snippets and upload link: https://artifacts.redwood/example/rca/1777903001/dumps.tar.gz

liam: slab histograms (trimmed):
```
slab-size buckets: [64, 128, 256, 512, 1k, 2k, 4k, 8k]
before: hot buckets: 512,1k,2k have high sustained occupancy; many small holes between 8k-32k ranges
after: holes reduced but still gaps at ~12-18k contiguous pages
```

sofia: decision log for live incident:
- mitigation applied (batch limit + disable continuous batching) — success to reduce immediate OOMs.
- follow-up: schedule deeper RCA to confirm whether PR #2124 introduced regressions OR whether workload distribution changed (seq_len spikes).
- remediation options: immediate backfill patch to allocator to coalesce free spans on eviction, or short-term rolling compaction job to defragment KV cache.

raj: michelle, please keep the override for 90m and then we'll incrementally restore while monitoring. runbook update: add check for kv fragmentation ratio > 0.6 as automated throttle trigger.

michelle: set override exp to 90m. infra-bot: CONFIG-EXPIRY: route override for runtime/multi-gen expires at 2026-03-15T16:35:03Z.

eva: CS note: notifying top 5 affected customers, offering incident summary and ETA for fix.

sofia: follow-up actions (owners):
- liam: deep analysis of slab histograms + repro workload in staging (due EOD)
- michelle: run short-term compaction experiment in staging (low risk) and prepare allocator rollback if needed (due tomorrow morning)
- raj: customer communication + update support ticket with current mitigation
- sofia: consolidate timeline and attach artifacts to incident ticket

michelle: quick experiment plan to validate fragmentation hypothesis: in staging, run identical batch/seq distribution with and without continuous-batching and compare contiguous free spans after 1h. I'll report results here.

liam: one more note — there were several `fallback triggered -> smaller-model-1` entries in logs; we should check model cache eviction behavior alongside KV cache. Cross-impact possible.

sofia: good catch. add model cache stats to artifacts list.

raj: closing loop for now: mitigation reduced customer errors, on-call handing back to standard rotation in 20m if stable. I'll monitor for recurrence.

sofia: thanks team. We'll keep this thread as the canonical RCA coordination. Please upload any additional logs to the artifacts link and ping when you have the slab analysis.

pagerduty-bot: INCIDENT: severity -> degraded (92m). next update expected by 2026-03-15T15:35:03Z.

michelle: uploaded slab analysis & KV metrics to the ticket. link: https://artifacts.redwood/example/rca/1777903001/analysis.pdf

liam: lab repro run started at 15:42. will post results.

sofia: leaving this thread pinned for RCA. tagging next oncall @raj for 15:30 handoff.

raj: acknowledged.
